cuda_driver_capability: NVIDIA-SMI reports CUDA UMD 13.3; toolkit not configured

same_frames_comparison.note: Three-frame sample, four CPU threads; model loading excluded. Both runs omit preview. RSS is process RAM, not VRAM.

full_nasa_gpu_metrics.cpu_percent_note: process CPU can exceed 100% on multicore

model_resources.confidence_semantics: Grounding DINO detector score; not calibrated probability
model_resources.provider_note: DirectML accelerates supported operators; unsupported/shape operators may execute on CPU.

notes: Playback FPS is not original sensor capture cadence.
Processing latency includes inference, association, JSON serialization; excludes preview encoding.
Model loading excluded; first inference included. RSS sampled once per frame.
Uncalibrated observations have null camera and rover position; no metric coordinates inferred.

pilot_accuracy.scope: Pilot manual annotation: left view of First AutoNav, frames 0/10/20; visible individual rocks with bbox width >=30 and height >=20 pixels. Smaller stones and boundary-truncated objects excluded; preliminary visual labels, not a validated benchmark.
pilot_accuracy.tracking_note: ID switches between successive matches of an annotated ID, including gaps; not IDF1/MOTA.

provider_profile_single_frame.note: Measured provider node events after graph promotion; not GPU utilization or time percentages.

tests.skip_reason: optional PyTorch model weights absent; real ONNX GPU offline test executed

limits: Three-frame annotation pilot is not a benchmark for the full video.
71 distinct tracker IDs across 116 observations; large timelapse motion causes fragmentation; reliable long-term tracking not established.
Large-box filtering can reject a very close large rock.
GPU inference includes some CPU operators; DirectML is not CUDA.
FP32 promotion cannot recover precision lost in upstream FP16 conversion.
